   **Bugs and stability.**

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Kad2011_, Sep 30, 2026, 3/5: "I actually LOVE this app. I found it this week and I’d already had so much more focus when using it, but it drains my battery so much. I thought it may have just been my phone, but my friend who recommended it is getting the same issue so we’re going to stop using sadly 💔"
            2. _if-you-see-kay you_, Oct 14, 2026, 4/5: "New update won’t let me scroll down on reading tag so that I can start my session. Also idk if we were supposed to have a button to block apps for the x1.3 boost only during focus sessions but it literally won’t let me agree or scroll down. App drains battery. Cute app tho I like the new outfits but it’s buggy sometimes"
            3. _Su Zazai_, Oct 12, 2026, 4/5: "It makes studying something I actually look forward to doing which is very strange as I practically hated studying the only thing is I experience this bug that when I get off the app I can still hear the music and I’ve deactivated the music but it still plays it only stopped when I uninstalled the app ."
